variant.author: Serifaz
variant.changelog:
Complete overhaul to the entire plugin, it's theming and functionality.
ADDED:
A theme section for theming your profile to your liking, with a theme gallery to shop for themes aswell. (Themes are managed and approved by moderation)
A new RP feed for posting recruitments, venue adverts or just lfrp posts.
An overarching profile for accounts with rp preferences
Image cropping for all image uploads
Video, audio and image uploading now available in galleries.
VLC Video renderer for rendering videos directly in the plugin 
Video backgrounds for profiles.
Relationships can now be formed between profiles and can be viewed by others to see how people know each other IC
Systems now allow you to roll for stats and skill points if the dm chooses.

FIXES:
Fixed an issue where profiles where not loading properly after verification.
Many fixes and quality of life changes to settings including hiding the dtr bar button and right click options when right clicking players.

NOTES:
Tons more but I am having a hard time remembering all I did.
